name: mcp-linker-skills
description: Curated and community agent skills for MCP Linker's Skills page.

skills.name: ios-signing-troubleshooting
skills.description: Diagnose iOS code signing, provisioning profile, entitlement and certificate errors from Xcode or xcodebuild. Use when a build, archive or export fails with signing errors, "No profiles found", "Provisioning profile doesn't include", or keychain problems.

skills.name: ios-simulator-build-run
skills.description: Build an iOS app and run it on the Simulator, then read build errors, logs and screenshots. Use when asked to build, run, launch, test or debug an iOS/iPadOS app, or when xcodebuild fails.

skills.name: ios-simulator-ui-automation
skills.description: Drive a booted iOS Simulator like a user with the axe CLI (describe-ui, tap, swipe, type, screenshot, record-video) to verify UI flows, reproduce bugs and capture screenshots. Use when asked to tap, scroll, type into, screenshot or smoke-test a running iOS app.

skills.name: ios-testflight-release
skills.description: Archive an iOS app, upload it to TestFlight and submit it to the App Store using the asc (App Store Connect) CLI, with a pre-release checklist. Use when asked to ship, release, upload a build, distribute a beta, or submit to App Review.

skills.name: macos-build-test
skills.description: Build, run and test macOS apps and Swift packages from the command line with XcodeBuildMCP, xcodebuild and swift. Use when asked to build, launch, test or debug a macOS target, a Swift package, or a menu bar, AppKit or SwiftUI Mac app.

skills.name: macos-notarize-distribute
skills.description: Sign with Developer ID, notarize with Apple, staple and package a macOS app as a DMG or ZIP for distribution outside the Mac App Store, using codesign and the asc CLI. Use when asked to notarize, staple, or ship a Mac app directly.
